name: P2 Gold Inc.
summary: P2 Gold Inc., a mineral exploration company, engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral resource properties primarily in the United States. It explores for gold, copper, and silver deposits. The company primarily holds a 100% interest in the Gabbs project that consists of 543 unpatented lode mining claims and one patented lode mining claim covering an area of 4,500 hectares located on the Walker-Lane Trend in the Fairplay Mining district of Nye County, Nevada. P2 Gold Inc. was formerly known as Central Timmins Exploration Corp. and changed its name to P2 Gold Inc. in August 2020. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
